rules: for each of the six categories pick the test image whose A1_L - A1_J pixel AP is the median and one whose difference is the most negative and one the most positive, by a rule fixed before looking at the maps
show the same sample_id across methods (B, C, A1_J, A1_L, DUP_J) so the panels are comparable; never mix sample ids between methods in one figure
if a category has fewer than three abnormal images, show all of them and state the count
include at least one counter-example figure: a category where A1_L - A1_J is negative (bracket_black seed0/K4) and one where it is positive (connector)
every figure must be reproducible from per_image.csv plus patch_scores.npz; the caption must state seed, K, stride and that the selection is explanatory, not confirmatory
do not select figures by which method looks best, and do not present a selected figure as independent statistical evidence
forbidden: choosing lambda or support images after seeing these figures
dropping a category because its illustrative example is unfavourable
